documents.text:
CONSULTANCY TERMS (fictional)

1. Duration
1.1 This Agreement runs for twenty-four (24) months from 1 March 2026.
1.2 Either party may end this Agreement on two (2) months' notice.

2. Fees
2.1 The Client shall pay each invoice within fourteen (14) days.

3. Records
3.1 The Consultant shall keep records of its work for six (6) years after this Agreement ends.
